content.text:
The interrupted Google import finished successfully when I resumed it.

**Job:** `job_0a5a224795a2` (activity, 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-03). It was interrupted by the provider outage. After resuming, all 18 planned requests returned OK.

**Activity coverage:**
- **Steps:** 3 daily records, one for each day from Oct 1 to Oct 3, 2026. This is the only activity metric with data.
- **Empty but successful:** 13 activity request groups returned no records. These were active energy burned, active minutes, active zone minutes, activity level, altitude, basal energy burned, calories in heart rate zone, distance, floors, sedentary period, swim lengths, time in heart rate zone, and total calories. The API returned nothing for these days, so they are not stored locally. This doesn't necessarily mean the data doesn't exist, but for this window there's nothing to report.

**Limitations:**
- The import only covers Oct 1–3, 2026. Other dates are not imported yet.
- The sync state shows Google data is synced through 2026-10-03.
- Other categories (sleep, heart, body, and so on) have no local Google records yet, because this job only imported activity.
